services.desc: Located in the heart of Forks, Washington, the Dew Drop Inn offers a serene and comfortable retreat for travelers exploring the breathtaking Olympic Peninsula. Our central location provides easy access to iconic natural wonders such as the Hoh Rainforest, La Push beaches, Lake Crescent, and the Sol Duc River. Whether you’re here for hiking, fishing, beachcombing, or simply to relax amidst nature, the Dew Drop Inn serves as your perfect basecamp.
